Earlier, he helped establish Wasserstein Perella and ran its merchant-banking arm. He now combines private investing with senior board leadership at companies spanning travel, energy, rare earths and gaming technology.

long_biography.plain_text:
At Coopers & Lybrand, Weisenburger learned accounting before moving to First Boston and joining Wasserstein Perella’s founding team. There he specialised in leveraged acquisitions, eventually becoming chief executive of its private-equity subsidiary. Assignments across portfolio companies ranged from manufacturing turnarounds to leadership posts at Maybelline and American Lawyer Media.

At Omnicom, he spent sixteen years building the finance function of a global advertising and communications group. His work encompassed capital markets, accounting, risk management and development of finance leaders across the organisation. That blend of transaction and operating experience later made him a recurring choice for audit, compensation and governance committees in travel, energy, materials and consumer-technology companies.
